issues.basis: The anonymous package exposes a one-command entrypoint and binds the eight shards, 536 raw artifacts, exact execution source, factorial rows, storage timelines, oracle sidecars, and mutant receipts. Lightweight replay checks confirmed 96 factorial configurations, eight oracle rows, nine matched pairs, and byte-identical generated table sources.

The storage specification defines normalized identity, shape/stride/offset interval construction, phase guards, and the conservative boundary. Seven adversarial storage tests passed; recorded totals cover 253440 storage rows and 236160 binding rows.

The visible manuscript uses pre-specified windows, distinguishes the 0.005 tolerance from the observed maximum, and limits the independent oracle to captured post-RoPE attention rows rather than an end-to-end or GDN oracle.

The main text uses descriptive cohort and factor names, the architecture remains legible, and internal artifact identifiers are confined to definitions and the artifact appendix. The separate transfer component of R3-005 remains under experiment and is not closed by this verdict.

table_allocation.basis: Moving row-level and provenance detail out of the main text did not remove the oracle, factorial, fault-sensitivity, or memory argument; these remain visible in Figure 2 and the result prose.
